Account Executive Job at Fortics Lifecare Limited




        
    

        
        Fortics Lifecare Limited is a management company dedicated to enhancing healthcare delivery across Nigeria. With a focus on managing and expanding primary and secondary care assets, the company supports a network of cottage hospitals. Fortics Lifecare combines a robust clinical governance framework and cloud-based data systems to ensure the delivery of cost-effective and quality care. Driven by a mission to inspire hope and promote health, the organisation integrates clinical practice, education, and research to address healthcare needs effectively. 
     

            
    



Fortics Lifecare is to be a leading healthcare holding company in Africa, developing existing healthcare assets into world-class health facilities across the continent integrating quality service delivery to clients and financial prosperity for our sake, to inspire and promote hope, health and total wellbeing by providing the best care for every patient through integrated clinical practice, continuos education and research, delivering this service at cost-effective prices.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Account Executive

Job Location: Lekki, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Summary


	We are seeking a detail-oriented and responsible Account executive to join our Finance Team.
	The successful candidate will be responsible for maintaining accurate financial records, processing accounting transactions, managing receivables and payables, performing reconciliations, and supporting financial reporting and compliance activities.


Key Responsibilities


	Record and maintain accurate financial transactions and accounting records.
	Process invoices, payments, receipts, and other accounting entries.
	Manage accounts receivable and payable.
	Monitor outstanding debts and support debt recovery activities.
	Perform regular bank and cash reconciliations.
	Support the preparation of financial reports and month-end/year-end closing activities.
	Ensure compliance with company financial policies, internal controls, accounting standards, and statutory requirements.
	Assist with internal and external audit processes.
	Maintain proper financial documentation and records.
	Support continuous improvement within the Finance function.


Requirements


	HND or B.Sc in Accounting, Finance, or a related discipline.
	Minimum of 1 year of relevant accounting experience
	Good knowledge of accounting principles and financial record-keeping.
	Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and accounting software.
	Strong attention to detail, accuracy, and numerical ability.
	Good organisational and communication skills.
	Ability to work independently and meet deadlines.


Salary
N150,000 – N200,000 Monthly.

Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should submit their updated CV to: staff [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the email. 

Note


	Applicants must reside within Lekki and its environs.
	Accommodation is not provided.

With over 20years industry experience and service oriented professional approach, we have earned the loyalty of our clients as a reliable partner. Job Location: Ikeja, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time (On-site)

Summary
     

            
    




	We urgently seeks to hire Junior Accountant, preferably male, for gender balance.

Qualifications


	Bachelor’s Degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field.
	Minimum of 3 years in finance or accounting job role.Understanding of accounting principles, financial reporting, and budgeting.
	Proficiency in accounting software and Odoo.
	Attention to detail and accuracy in financial reporting.

	HMO + Pensions + Paid Holidays + Paid Annual Leave.

Call Centre Executive Job at Roundsquare Integrated Services Limited




        
    

        
        Roundsquare Integrated Services Limited - Our client, an established Travel Agency, is recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Call Centre Executive 

Job Location: Lekki, Lagos

Employment Type: Full-time, shift-based role

Job Summary
     

            
    




	Our client, an established travel agency, is seeking polite, responsive and client-focused Call Centre Executives to support its customer service and enquiry management operations.
	The successful candidates will handle incoming calls, WhatsApp messages, emails, live chat enquiries, CRM updates, client follow-up, complaint escalation and shift handover.
	This is a shift-based role. The successful candidates must be willing to work extended-coverage shifts based on the company’s approved roster.


Key Requirements


	First Degree or HND in Business Administration, Mass Communication, Marketing, Tourism, Hospitality, Management or a related field.
	1 to 3 years of relevant experience in call centre operations, customer service, client relations, travel agency operations, hospitality, aviation, sales support or a related service environment.
	Experience handling calls, WhatsApp messages, emails, live chat, CRM systems or customer service platforms will be an advantage.
	Good oral and written communication skills for client interaction, enquiry handling, CRM updates, escalation and reporting.
	Ability to work on a shift basis, including morning, afternoon, evening, weekend or extended coverage shifts.
	Strong attention to detail, patience, confidentiality, follow-up discipline and client service attitude.


Salary
N150,000 monthly gross.
